title: Reward-guided Fine-Tuning of One-Step Generative Models via Wasserstein Gradient Flow
abstract: arXiv:2608.29647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To mitigate the time complexity of generative models, one-step generative models have recently emerged through direct mapping from noise to data in a single forward pass. However, the reward-guided fine-tuning method of one-step generative models remains largely unexplored. To address this, we consider one-step generators from an optimal transport view, investigating Wasserstein Gradient Flow (WGF) for modeling smooth and controlled distributional evolution in probability space. We then propose a novel reward-guided fine-tuning of a one-step generative model via WGF. We derive a practical training method that requires no reward gradients, thereby handling both non-differentiable and differentiable rewards. Moreover, our method provides smooth and stable reward-guided distributional updates while mitigating reward hacking and mode collapse. translated_title: 基于Wasserstein梯度流的一步生成模型奖励引导微调
translated_abstract: 为了降低生成模型的时间复杂度，一步生成模型最近应运而生，它通过单次前向传播直接将噪声映射为数据。然而，针对一步生成模型的奖励引导微调方法在很大程度上仍未被探索。为解决这一问题，我们从最优传输的视角考察一步生成器，研究Wasserstein梯度流（WGF）以在概率空间中建模平滑且可控的分布演化。在此基础上，我们提出了一种通过WGF对一步生成模型进行奖励引导微调的新方法。我们推导出一种实用的训练方法，该方法无需奖励梯度，因此既能处理不可微的奖励，也能处理可微的奖励。此外，我们的方法能够实现平滑且稳定的奖励引导分布更新，同时缓解奖励欺骗和模式崩溃问题。在2D合成数据、CIFAR-10以及ImageNet 256×256上使用多种奖励的实验表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出基于Wasserstein梯度流的奖励引导微调方法，无需奖励梯度即可对一步生成模型实现平滑稳定的分布更新，并能同时处理可微与不可微奖励、缓解奖励欺骗和模式崩溃问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a reward-guided fine-tuning method for one-step generative models based on Wasserstein Gradient Flow, which requires no reward gradients, handles both differentiable and non-differentiable rewards, and achieves smooth, stable distributional updates while mitigating reward hacking and mode collapse.
